title: Observability quickstart: storyboard and annotated screenshots for latency / cost / traces
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a focused set of onboarding/quickstart visual assets that demonstrate Redwood Console observability features: end-to-end request tracing (flamegraph / span timeline), cost-per-token waterfall, and latency breakdowns. Assets must include desktop and mobile responsive variants, annotated callouts for docs, and a small set of export-ready PNG/SVGs for the release notes and quickstart guide.
acceptance_criteria: Primary hero screenshot: console route page showing latency summary + cost-per-token waterfall with annotations (PNG + SVG)
Trace view: annotated span timeline / mini-flamegraph highlighting cold-start vs KV-cache hits (desktop + mobile)
Latency breakdown: per-route P50/P95 table and stacked bar visualization, annotated for docs copy
All assets exported in 2x resolution PNG and vector-friendly SVG where possible
Figma file updated with separate components for annotations, overlays, and helper tokens; FigJam quick walkthrough for PM/Eng review
design_assets: FigJam: Observability Quickstart Walkthrough v2 (link in attachments)
